first_theme_representative_quotes.quote: Money, he argued, is a pseudo-rational device: it creates the illusion that all outcomes can be rendered commensurate through a single unit of account, masking the presence of genuine uncertainty about both facts and values.
The object of collective choice is never values as such, but rival existential and political projects that embed different interpretations of what those values might mean in practice.
